title: Agentic Root Cause Reasoning and Localization of Unsoundness in Static Call Graph Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.29745v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Static call graph tools cannot soundly model every dynamic language feature, yet rarely reveal when, where, or why their results are unsound. We present CGRizz, an agentic framework that diagnoses unsoundness for developers and warns users about it. During training, CGRizz compares static and dynamic call graphs to identify boundary edges: calls observed at runtime but missing from the static graph. For each edge, an LLM agent proposes a root cause, including the unmodeled program pattern and responsible tool location. CGRizz validates each proposal using three independent forms of evidence: runtime instrumentation detecting the pattern, a test case reproducing the missing edge, and a warning inserted at the implicated tool location. Validated reports help developers diagnose limitations, while the warnings form an instrumented build that flags potential unsoundness in new programs without dynamic analysis. translated_title: 静态调用图分析中不健全性的智能体式根因推理与定位
translated_abstract: 静态调用图工具无法健全地建模所有动态语言特性，却很少揭示其结果在何时、何地、为何不健全。我们提出了 CGRizz，一个为开发者诊断不健全性并向用户发出警告的智能体式框架。在训练阶段，CGRizz 通过比较静态调用图与动态调用图来识别边界边，即运行时观察到但静态图中缺失的调用。对于每一条这样的边，一个 LLM 智能体会提出根因假设，包括未被建模的程序模式以及相应的工具代码位置。CGRizz 使用三种相互独立的证据来验证每个假设：检测该模式的运行时插桩、重现缺失边的测试用例，以及在涉事工具位置插入的警告。经过验证的报告帮助开发者诊断工具的局限性，而这些警告则构成一个插桩构建版本，无需动态分析即可在新程序中标记潜在的不健全性。我们在三个基准上评估了 CGRizz……
tldr: 提出智能体框架 CGRizz，通过对比静态与动态调用图定位缺失的调用边，由 LLM 智能体推理不健全性的根因，并用运行时插桩、复现测试用例和工具位置警告三重独立证据加以验证，实现对静态调用图分析缺陷的诊断与自动预警。
en_tdlr: CGRizz is an agentic framework that diagnoses unsoundness in static call graph analysis by identifying missing runtime call edges, having an LLM agent reason about root causes, and validating proposals with three independent forms of evidence—runtime instrumentation, reproduction test cases, and tool-level warnings—thereby enabling warnings that flag potential unsoundness in new programs without dynamic analysis.
